definitions.description: Claude API access through one exact runtime environment variable.

adapters.refresh_behavior: replace the host variable and recreate the session
adapters.revocation_behavior: stop the active session, revoke approval, and rotate the provider key
adapters.backup_policy: no Cyclestone credential copy; host and process retention remain external

definitions.security_guidance: The API key is inherited by name only at runtime and is readable by every process running as the container user.

definitions.description: Exact file-backed Codex authentication without configuration, logs, or sessions.

adapters.refresh_behavior: host file changes require session recreation
adapters.revocation_behavior: stop the active session, revoke approval, and rotate provider credentials when disclosure is suspected
adapters.backup_policy: no Cyclestone copy; host backups may retain the source file

adapters.import_behavior: atomic project-scoped import of the one reviewed regular file
adapters.synchronization: explicit provider-specific atomic replacement of the source file
adapters.refresh_behavior: refresh in the isolated file, then explicitly synchronize
adapters.revocation_behavior: refuse while a tracked session is active, then delete isolated state and revoke approval
adapters.backup_policy: exclude the isolated store from backups; restored copies require revocation and provider-side rotation

definitions.security_guidance: File-backed auth.json is required; keyring-only authentication fails closed. Read-write access applies only to a project-scoped isolated copy.

definitions.description: Three exact proxy variable names forwarded only at runtime.

adapters.refresh_behavior: replace host variables and recreate the session
adapters.revocation_behavior: stop the active session and revoke approval
adapters.backup_policy: no Cyclestone credential copy; host and process retention remain external

definitions.security_guidance: Proxy URLs can contain credentials; values are never serialized or printed.

definitions.description: Unauthenticated access to one reviewed host-service endpoint selected by OLLAMA_HOST.

adapters.refresh_behavior: change the runtime endpoint and recreate the session
adapters.revocation_behavior: stop the active session and revoke approval

definitions.security_guidance: Only the reviewed unauthenticated endpoint is supported; no engine socket or model directory is exposed.

definitions.description: Exact OpenCode authentication in a project-scoped isolated store.

adapters.import_behavior: atomic project-scoped import of the one reviewed regular file
adapters.synchronization: explicit provider-specific atomic replacement of the source file
adapters.refresh_behavior: refresh in the isolated file, then explicitly synchronize
adapters.revocation_behavior: refuse while a tracked session is active, then delete isolated state and revoke approval
adapters.backup_policy: exclude the isolated store from backups; restored copies require revocation and provider-side rotation

definitions.security_guidance: Only auth.json is accepted; configuration, sessions, logs, databases, caches, and adjacent files are excluded.
